domain-information: A Customer asks for help choosing an instrument to find one that fits their skill level and music style.
A Customer signs a rental agreement to use an instrument for a short period before committing to a purchase.
A Sales Associate evaluates the customer’s needs to recommend suitable brands and models.
A Sales Associate prepares a rental package so the instrument is ready for pickup on the same day.
A Repair Technician inspects a damaged instrument to diagnose issues that affect playability.
A Repair Technician performs adjustments and repairs to restore the instrument to proper condition.
An Inventory Manager checks stock levels to ensure commonly rented or purchased instruments are available.
An Inventory Manager logs incoming shipments to update the store’s catalog for the sales team.
A Quality Specialist checks instruments before they go on display to guarantee they meet store standards.
A Quality Specialist verifies repaired instruments to confirm they are ready for customer pickup.
